inputs.prompt: Animate the exact HAND-DRAWN 2D ANIME rendering in <Picture 1>, using <Video 1> ONLY as the motion and acting guide. Picture 1 is the absolute visual style and character design target for EVERY frame: clean dark ink outlines, flat orange hair color with broad flat highlight bands, matte flat skin with hard cel shadow shapes, hand-drawn lace and orange embroidery, detailed painted gothic background. Do not inherit the glossy 3D rendering, soft gradients or realistic material highlights from the video. Same character, expression arc, composition, tilted camera angle, chained wrists, wooden cross and costume as Picture 1. Keep linework and two-tone cel coloring stable throughout. Hair moves as drawn connected locks, not shiny rendered strands. The veil and dress have subtle drawn movement. No extra characters, no camera movement, no cuts, no text or subtitles, no fire. Reproduce the quieter pleading performance from Video 1: her protective anger softens into concern, lips part to address the offscreen priest, brief pause, then she finishes her plea and closes her lips. Keep her eyes down toward the offscreen priest and child. Only one expressive arc, no repeating struggle or shouting cycles. End with a brief attentive look.
